name: MS-02
label: Safe D

key_factors: Longtime incumbent Bennie Thompson with large cash advantage
Republican challenger minimally funded and no outside spending
model.rationale: Thompson holds a heavily Democratic seat, a huge financial edge, and no serious outside opposition, while markets price him near certain. The fundamentals point to a comfortable double-digit win.
model.watch: Any late outside spending or a polling surprise showing a single-digit race would warrant revisiting.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Mississippi's 2nd District is a solidly Democratic seat, and longtime incumbent Bennie Thompson is seeking another term. He has raised over $770,000 and holds more than $1.4 million on hand, while Republican Ron Eller has raised under $50,000 with no outside support on either side. An independent candidate trails far behind in resources.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets give Thompson roughly a 97% chance of winning. The district's Democratic lean and incumbency advantage point to a comfortable Thompson victory, with the main uncertainty being how low turnout or a strong national environment could shift the margin.
